from invoice import total_label

    return f'"'${cents / 100:.2f}'"'

for cents in (0, 1, 99, 100, 12345, -1, -12345):
    actual = total_label(cents)
    assert actual == format_usd(cents)
    print(f'{cents}: {actual}')
